pitches.logline: A father must pick up his daughter from a birthday at a house he has never been to, with only a map pin in a chat; VINARI opens the link as the destination and the turns come up on his car's own screen, in Georgian.
pitches.hook: His phone on the passenger seat buzzes and his daughter's voice yells through the speaker, the car stopped at a dark fork (real-phone-buzz)

pitches.logline: A first-time buyer is about to pay for a US-imported BMW the seller swears has barely been driven; the OBD check reads the mileage in the engine computer and finds the listing's number was miles written as kilometres.
pitches.hook: The seller slams the BMW's door and slaps the roof, shouting his pitch over the drizzle (real-door)

pitches.logline: A grandson drives his grandmother home to Kakheti with jars of honey on her lap, and every speed bump earns him a scolding; the navigator's Georgian voice starts warning before bumps and crossings, and grandma takes the credit.
pitches.hook: The car hits a hidden bump and the jars clink on grandma's lap as she yells at him (real-clunk)

treatment.logline: Nika, buying his first car at the Rustavi market, is about to pay for a 2019-or-newer US-imported crossover the seller swears has 40 000 on it; the pre-purchase OBD check compares the engine computer's mileage with the listing and catches miles written as kilometres.
treatment.hero: Nika, young first-time buyer, bomber jacket, curly dark hair; the same dark crossover and the same pushy seller in black leather all film
treatment.obstacle: the seller's pressure and a dashboard number that looks right, with another buyer circling

hook.event: The seller slams the car's door and throws his arms up by it, shouting his number over the drizzle

act1: Nika sits at the wheel and the dashboard shows the same 40 000: looks right
another buyer circles the car and the seller hurries Nika: a little longer and it's gone
Nika already has the cash out of his jacket
treatment.turn: his hand stops, the cash goes back; rain on the roof, a beat of silence: it is an American car

reveal.what: the phone rises out of the dark on the home screen: the new pre-purchase check

screens.step: the phone reads the car through the adapter

treatment.payoff: Nika turns the phone to the same seller, who mumbles that it is miles, yes; Nika: then let's say the price in miles too
treatment.signature: Two odometer plates, the listing's and the engine computer's, both 40 000; the km label peels off the engine's and a hard stamp lands mi
